contents.html: Abstract
contents.html_ja: 要旨

contents.html: Federal Information Processing Standard 201-3 (FIPS 201-3) defines the requirements for Personal Identity Verification (PIV) life cycle activities, including identity proofing, registration, PIV Card issuance, and PIV Card usage. FIPS 201-3 also defines the structure of an identity credential that includes cryptographic keys. This document contains the technical specifications needed for the mandatory and optional cryptographic keys specified in FIPS 201-3, as well as the supporting infrastructure specified in FIPS 201-3 and the related NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-73, Interfaces for Personal Identity Verification, and SP 800-76, Biometric Specifications for Personal Identity Verification, which rely on cryptographic functions.
contents.html_ja: 連邦情報処理標準201-3（FIPS 201-3）は、個人識別検証（PIV）のライフサイクル活動に関する要件を定めており、本人確認、登録、PIVカードの発行および利用を含む。FIPS 201-3は、暗号鍵を含む本人識別認証情報の構造も定めている。本書は、FIPS 201-3が規定する必須および任意の暗号鍵に必要な技術仕様に加え、FIPS 201-3、ならびに関連するNIST特別刊行物（SP）800-73「個人識別検証のインタフェース」およびSP 800-76「個人識別検証の生体仕様」で規定される、暗号機能に依存する支援インフラストラクチャに必要な技術仕様を含む。

contents.html: 1. Introduction
contents.html_ja: 1. 序文

contents.html: Homeland Security Presidential Directive-12 (HSPD-12) mandated the creation of new standards for interoperable identity credentials for physical and logical access to Federal Government locations and systems. Federal Information Processing Standard 201 (FIPS 201), Personal Identity Verification (PIV) of Federal Employees and Contractors, was developed to establish standards for identity credentials [FIPS201]. This document, NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-78-5, specifies the cryptographic algorithms and key sizes for PIV systems and is a companion document to FIPS 201-3.
contents.html_ja: 国土安全保障大統領指令12（HSPD-12）は、連邦政府の施設およびシステムへの物理的・論理的アクセスに用いる、相互運用可能な本人識別認証情報の新しい標準の策定を命じた。連邦情報処理標準201（FIPS 201）「連邦職員および請負業者の個人識別検証（PIV）」は、本人識別認証情報の標準を確立するために策定された[ FIPS201 ]。本書、NIST特別刊行物（SP）800-78-5は、PIVシステムで使用する暗号アルゴリズムと鍵長を規定し、FIPS 201-3の補足文書となる。

contents.html: 1.1. Purpose
contents.html_ja: 1.1 目的

contents.html: FIPS 201-3 defines the requirements for PIV life cycle activities, including identity proofing, registration, PIV Card issuance, and PIV Card usage. FIPS 201-3 also defines the structure of an identity credential that includes cryptographic keys. This document contains the technical specifications needed for the mandatory and optional cryptographic keys specified in FIPS 201-3, as well as the supporting infrastructure specified in FIPS 201-3 and the related SP 800-73, Interfaces for Personal Identity Verification [SP800-73], and SP 800-76, Biometric Specifications for Personal Identity Verification [SP800-76], which rely on cryptographic functions.
contents.html_ja: FIPS 201-3は、本人確認、登録、PIVカードの発行および使用など、PIVのライフサイクル活動に関する要件を定める。また、暗号鍵を含む本人識別認証情報の構造も定める。本書は、FIPS 201-3が規定する必須および任意の暗号鍵に必要な技術仕様と、暗号機能に依存する関連インフラストラクチャ（FIPS 201-3、SP 800-73「個人識別検証のインタフェース」[SP800-73]、SP 800-76「個人識別検証の生体仕様」[SP800-76]で規定）に必要な仕様を示す。

contents.html: 1.2. Scope
contents.html_ja: 1.2 適用範囲

contents.html: The scope of this recommendation encompasses the PIV Card, infrastructure components that support issuance and management of the PIV Card, and applications that rely on the credentials supported by the PIV Card to provide security services. This recommendation identifies acceptable symmetric and asymmetric encryption algorithms, digital signature algorithms, key establishment schemes, and message digest algorithms and specifies mechanisms to identify the algorithms associated with PIV keys or digital signatures.
contents.html_ja: 本勧告の適用範囲には、PIVカード、その発行と管理を支援するインフラストラクチャの構成要素、およびPIVカードがサポートする認証情報を利用してセキュリティサービスを提供するアプリケーションが含まれる。本勧告は、許容される共通鍵・公開鍵暗号アルゴリズム、デジタル署名アルゴリズム、鍵確立方式、メッセージダイジェストアルゴリズムを特定し、PIV鍵またはデジタル署名に関連付けるアルゴリズムを識別する仕組みを規定する。

contents.html: Algorithms and key sizes have been selected for consistency with applicable federal standards and to ensure adequate cryptographic strength for PIV applications.
contents.html_ja: アルゴリズムと鍵長は、適用される連邦標準との整合性を保ち、PIVアプリケーションに十分な暗号強度を確保するよう選定されている。

contents.html: 1.3. Audience and Assumptions
contents.html_ja: 1.3 想定読者と前提

contents.html: This document is intended for federal agencies and implementers of PIV systems. Readers are assumed to have a working knowledge of cryptography and public key infrastructure (PKI) technology.
contents.html_ja: 本書は、連邦機関およびPIVシステムの実装者を対象とする。読者は、暗号技術および公開鍵基盤（PKI）技術の実務知識を有しているものとする。

contents.html: FIPS 201-3 employs cryptographic mechanisms to authenticate cardholders, secure information stored on the PIV Card, and secure the supporting infrastructure. FIPS 201-3 and its supporting documents specify a suite of keys to be stored on the PIV Card for personal identity verification, digital signature generation, and key management. The PIV cryptographic keys specified in FIPS 201-3 and SP 800-73 are:

Card management systems are authenticated through the use of PIV Card Application Administration Keys. The cryptographic algorithms and key sizes that may be used for these keys are specified in Sec. 5.

contents.html: 3. On-Card Cryptographic Requirements
contents.html_ja: 3. カード内暗号要件

contents.html: FIPS 201-3 identifies a suite of objects that are stored on the PIV Card for use in authentication mechanisms or other security protocols. These objects may be divided into three classes: cryptographic keys, signed authentication information stored on the PIV Card, and message digests of information stored on the PIV Card. Cryptographic requirements for PIV keys are detailed in Sec. 3.1. Cryptographic requirements for other stored objects are detailed in Sec. 3.2.

contents.html: All cryptographic algorithms employed shall provide at least 112 bits of security strength. Cryptographic keys that will remain in use after 2030 should provide 128 bits of security strength.2 Federal departments and agencies should consider potential cryptographic key length migrations as part of their moderate to long-term cryptographic transition and modernization plans, including the need to plan and invest for a future migration to post-quantum algorithms. Capital investments for PIV issuance and relying party systems should be selected with an emphasis on ensuring a timely migration to post-quantum algorithms once standards, technologies, and services are available. If a migration to longer cryptographic keys would require significant resources or infrastructure upgrades, federal departments and agencies may elect to defer these improvements until the post-quantum migration. Post-quantum algorithms will be specified in a future revision of this document once foundational standards supporting their use have been adopted.
contents.html_ja: 使用するすべての暗号アルゴリズムは、少なくとも112ビットのセキュリティ強度を提供しなければならない。2030年以降も使用する暗号鍵は、128ビットのセキュリティ強度を提供することが望ましい。2 連邦省庁および機関は、中長期的な暗号移行・近代化計画の一環として、将来の耐量子アルゴリズムへの移行を計画し、そのために投資する必要性を含め、暗号鍵長の移行を検討することが望ましい。PIV発行システムおよび依拠当事者システムへの設備投資では、標準、技術およびサービスが利用可能になった後、耐量子アルゴリズムへ速やかに移行できることを重視して選定することが望ましい。より長い暗号鍵への移行に多大なリソースまたはインフラストラクチャの更新が必要となる場合、連邦省庁および機関は、耐量子移行までこうした改善を延期してよい。耐量子アルゴリズムの利用を支える基盤標準が採用された後、本書の将来の改訂版で耐量子アルゴリズムを規定する。

contents.html: PIV Cards may support card activation by the card management system to support card personalization and post-issuance card updates. PIV Cards that support card personalization and post-issuance updates perform a challenge-response protocol using a symmetric cryptographic key (i.e., the PIV Card Application Administration Key) to authenticate the card management system. contents.html: Algorithm identifiers '27' and '2E' represent suites of algorithms and key sizes for use with secure messaging and key establishment. Cipher Suite 2 (CS2) is used to establish session keys and for secure messaging when the PIV Secure Messaging key is an ECDH (Curve P-256) key. Cipher Suite 7 (CS7) is used to establish session keys and for secure messaging when the PIV Secure Messaging key is an ECDH (Curve P-384) key. Details of secure messaging, the key establishment protocol, and the algorithms and key sizes for these two cipher suites are specified in SP 800-73-4, Part 2.

contents.html: All cryptographic algorithms employed shall provide at least 112 bits of security strength. Cryptographic keys that will remain in use after 2030 should provide 128 bits of security strength.7 Federal departments and agencies should consider potential cryptographic key length migrations as part of their moderate to long-term cryptographic transition and modernization plans, including the need to plan and invest for a future migration to post-quantum algorithms. Capital investments for PIV issuance and relying party systems should be selected with an emphasis on ensuring a timely migration to post-quantum algorithms once standards, technologies, and services are available. If a migration to longer cryptographic keys would require significant resources or infrastructure upgrades, federal departments and agencies may elect to defer these improvements until the post-quantum migration. Post-quantum algorithms will be specified in a future revision of this document once foundational standards supporting their use have been adopted.

contents.html: This appendix is informative and provides an overview of the changes made to SP 800-78 since its initial release.

contents.html: In August 2007, Revision 1 enhanced alignment with the National Security Agency’s Suite B Cryptography by:
contents.html_ja: 2007年8月の改訂1では、米国国家安全保障局（NSA）のSuite B暗号との整合性を高めるため、次の変更を行った。

contents.html: Reducing the set of elliptic curves approved for use with PIV cards from six curves to two,
contents.html_ja: PIVカードで使用を承認する楕円曲線を6曲線から2曲線に削減、

contents.html: Adding SHA-384 with Curve P-384, and
contents.html_ja: 曲線P-384でSHA-384を追加、および

contents.html: Eliminating the largest size of RSA keys (3072 bits) on PIV cards.
contents.html_ja: PIVカード上のRSA鍵の最大長（3072ビット）を廃止。

contents.html: In February 2010, Revision 2 updates included:
contents.html_ja: 2010年2月の改訂2では、次の更新を行った。

contents.html: Realigning with the NSA Suite B Cryptographic specification by removing discontinued Elliptic Curve MQV as a key agreement scheme,
contents.html_ja: 廃止された鍵合意方式である楕円曲線MQVを削除し、NSA Suite B暗号仕様との整合性を再調整、

contents.html: Aligning with FIPS 186-3 by removing RSA 4096 as an algorithm and key size for generating signatures for PIV data objects, and
contents.html_ja: PIVデータオブジェクトの署名生成に用いるアルゴリズムおよび鍵長としてRSA 4096を削除し、FIPS 186-3との整合を実施、および

contents.html: Eliminating the redundant cipher block chaining (CBC) mode of encryption for symmetric authentication purposes (challenge and response)
contents.html_ja: 対称認証（チャレンジ・レスポンス）で使用する冗長な暗号ブロック連鎖（CBC）暗号化モードを廃止。

contents.html: In December 2010, Revision 3 updates included:
contents.html_ja: 2010年12月の改訂3では、次の更新を行った。

contents.html: Aligning the set of acceptable RSA public key exponents with FIPS 186-3 and
contents.html_ja: 許容されるRSA公開鍵指数の集合をFIPS 186-3と整合させ、および

contents.html: Extending the permitted use of SHA-1 after December 31, 2010, when signing revocation information under limited circumstances.
contents.html_ja: 限定的な状況において失効情報に署名する場合、2010年12月31日以降もSHA-1を使用できる期間を延長。

contents.html: In 2014, Revision 4 updates included:
contents.html_ja: 2014年の改訂4では、次の更新を行った。

contents.html: Adding algorithm and key size requirements for secure messaging,
contents.html_ja: セキュアメッセージングのアルゴリズムおよび鍵長の要件を追加、

contents.html: Adding Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) validation testing requirements, and
contents.html_ja: 暗号アルゴリズム検証プログラム（CAVP）の検証試験要件を追加、および

contents.html: Clarifying that RSA public keys may only have a public exponent of 65537.
contents.html_ja: RSA公開鍵の公開指数は65537に限られることを明確化。

contents.html: In 2024, Revision 5 updates incorporated the following changes:
contents.html_ja: 2024年の改訂5では、次の変更を取り入れた。

contents.html: Table 1 reflects additional higher strength keys with at least 128-bit security and suggested sunsets of lower sized keys by 2030 in anticipation of the recommended migration to 128-bit security strength in 2031,
contents.html_ja: 表1に、少なくとも128ビットのセキュリティ強度を持つ、より高強度の鍵を追加した。また、2031年に推奨される128ビットのセキュリティ強度への移行を見据え、鍵長の短い鍵を2030年までに段階的に廃止する時期の目安を示した。

contents.html: Accommodation of the Secure Messaging Authentication key,
contents.html_ja: セキュアメッセージング認証鍵に対応。

contents.html: Deprecation of the symmetric card authentication key,
contents.html_ja: 対称カード認証鍵を非推奨化。

contents.html: Deprecation of 3TDEA algorithm with identifiers ‘00’ and ‘03’,
contents.html_ja: 識別子‘00’および‘03’の3TDEAアルゴリズムを非推奨化。

contents.html: Removal of the retired RNG from CAVP PIV component testing, where applicable, and
contents.html_ja: 該当する場合、CAVPのPIVコンポーネント試験から廃止済みRNGを削除、および

contents.html: Removal of the retired FIPS 186-2 Key Generation component testing, where applicable.
contents.html_ja: 該当する場合、廃止済みFIPS 186-2鍵生成コンポーネント試験を削除。
